name: @solenoid/server-runtime
description: Runtime for rendering on the server. TBD

scripts.build-code: find ./src -name '*.ts' ! -path '*/__tests__/*' ! -name '*.test.ts' ! -name '*.spec.ts' -exec sh -c 'rel=$(echo "{}" | sed "s|^\./src/||;s|\.ts\$|.js|"); mkdir -p "./lib/$(dirname "$rel")"; bun build {} --outfile "./lib/$rel" --target node --no-bundle' \;
